verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the Web Call SDK, which lets a browser tab hold a live two-way conversation with a Bolna agent without telephony. A developer could use it to try an agent before phone deployment, but it is documented for embedding conversations in web pages, not as a testing feature. Call history and transcripts support debugging only after calls happen. Missing for 10: automated simulated conversations or test personas, an evals or test-suite framework, scoring or regression testing of agent behavior, a documented pre-deployment testing workflow, and independent corroboration.
